ApplyScript: local token = SunExp_RegisterHook(self, "SunExpSolarRadianceHook", "SunExpSolarRadianceToken"); if token == nil then return end; self:AddEvent("Action", function() if not SunExp_IsHookTokenActive(self, "SunExpSolarRadianceToken", token) then return end; local b = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance"); if b == nil then return end; local gain = b.buffConfig.Level * 5; if gain <= 0 then return end; self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("buff_extraordinary", tostring(gain)); end);

local token = SunExp_RegisterHook(self, "SunExpGatheredFlameHook", "SunExpGatheredFlameToken"); if token == nil then return end; self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() if not SunExp_IsHookTokenActive(self, "SunExpGatheredFlameToken", token) then return end; local b = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame"); if b == nil then return end; local count = b.buffConfig.Level; if count <= 0 then return end; SunExp_ApplySelfBurn(self, count, true); end);

local token = SunExp_RegisterHook(self, "SunExpSolarFieldHook", "SunExpSolarFieldToken"); if token == nil then return end; self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() if not SunExp_IsHookTokenActive(self, "SunExpSolarFieldToken", token) then return end; local b = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_field"); if b == nil then return end; local count = b.buffConfig.Level; if count <= 0 then return end; self:SetStatus("All"); self:AddBuff("buff_burn", tostring(count)); SunExp_ClearSelfBurnIfProtected(self, true); end);

self:SetStatus("Self"); self.Self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); SunExp_SetBurnWardPending(self, true); local token = SunExp_RegisterHook(self, "SunExpBurnWardHook", "SunExpBurnWardToken"); if token == nil then return end; self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() if not SunExp_IsHookTokenActive(self, "SunExpBurnWardToken", token) then return end; local ward = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_burn_ward"); local activeWard = false; if ward ~= nil and ward.buffConfig.Level > 0 then activeWard = true; end; local pending = SunExp_IsBurnWardPending(self); if not activeWard and not pending then return end; self.Self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); self.Self:RemoveBuff("SunExp_sunexp_burn_ward"); SunExp_SetBurnWardPending(self, true); self:AddTempEvent("EndRound", function() SunExp_SetBurnWardPending(self, false); end); end);

local token = SunExp_RegisterHook(self, "SunExpCrownStateHook", "SunExpCrownStateToken"); if token == nil then return end; self:AddEvent("Action", function() if not SunExp_IsHookTokenActive(self, "SunExpCrownStateToken", token) then return end; if self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_crown_state") == nil then return end; local level = SunExp_GetRadianceLevel(self); if level >= 8 then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:ChangePower("1"); if level < 12 then SunExp_ApplySelfBurn(self, 1, false); end end; if level >= 12 then self.Self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); end end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() if not SunExp_IsHookTokenActive(self, "SunExpCrownStateToken", token) then return end; if SunExp_HasCrownPhase(self, 12) then self.Self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); end end);
